svg.title: A webhook for one test run
svg.desc: Three lifelines: planner, test-runner and the planner webhook receiver on port 41250. The planner sends SendMessage with returnImmediately and a push configuration, and gets back the task in TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED at once. test-runner then posts eight notifications to the receiver: the working status with an Authorization Bearer header, five artifactUpdate chunks of test-log.txt, the summary.json artifact, and the completed status. The receiver answers each POST with 204 No Content. After the task has finished, the planner lists, reads, and deletes the push configuration, whose server-assigned id is 92c697ef.

g.text: no more POSTs for this config
